entities.name: MJ1542-like protein
observations: The 768-aa query matches reviewed Methanocaldococcus jannaschii protein Q58937 at 100% identity and 100% query coverage; the reference is labeled uncharacterized.
The query has Pfam AAA_21 (PF13304.13) at residues 462–539; reference GO annotations indicate ATP binding and ATP hydrolysis activity with ECO:0000501 evidence.
